_help: Shop Launch menu (docs/shop-launch.md). shop = display name, till = Odoo pos_config name, stockCode = its stock location top code, transitLocation = where the warehouse parks its stock on the way (Odoo Goods in Transit), workplanSheet = the opening-stock Google Sheet, workplanCsv = saved copy used when the sheet can't be read, benchmark = the earlier launch to race against, days = launch days covered.
